title: SAY THESE 10 WORDS EVERY MORNING AND YOUR LIFE WILL NEVER BE THE SAME
text: Oh, the fire, the fire of God. I feel it. I feel the tangible weight of the Holy Ghost right now. Something is pressing in the atmosphere. Something is descending, and I have learned when heaven begins to press before the word is released, it means God has been waiting for this moment longer than you have. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Before I speak, I just want to worship. Just worship with me for a moment. You are worthy, Lord. You are worthy of everything. You are worthy of our attention. You are worthy of our obedience. You are worthy of our surrender. We do not take this moment for granted. We do not treat your presence like background noise. You are the living God, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God who splits the Red Sea, the God who shut the mouths of lions, the God who made the sun stand still. And that same God, that same unchanging, undefeatable, uncontainable God is in this place right now. We worship you. We bow before you. We acknowledge that without you we can do nothing, but with you all with you all things are possible. Hallelujah. Now, I need you to do something before we proceed. This message you're about to hear, it is not ordinary. It was not designed by human intellect. What you are about to receive was forged in the furnace of the Holy Ghost. And there is someone, maybe someone you know, maybe someone you have never met, there is someone who is one message away from a total life transformation, and this is that message. So, I need you to be the courier. Share this right now. Send the link. Post it. Tag someone, because the Holy Spirit might use you as a delivery system for someone's miracle. Do not hoard what God is releasing. Let the fire spread. Sit down. Sit down wherever you are. Open your spirit because what God is about to deposit is going to change the trajectory of your mornings, your days, your weeks, your months, and ultimately the entire course of your life. I want to take you to a scripture, Proverbs chapter 18 verse 21. Solomon, writing by the inspiration of the Holy Ghost, made a declaration that should terrify and simultaneously empower every human being. He said, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Stop. Read that again in your spirit. Death and life, not just life. Death and life. Both outcomes are loaded in the same instrument, your tongue. The same mouth that can call forth blessings can also invoke destruction. The same voice that can prophesy destiny can also decree failure. And most people, listen to me, most people are using the most powerful weapon God gave them to destroy the very life God is trying to build for them. Every morning you wake up, your mouth is a loaded weapon. And the question is not whether it will fire, it will. You will speak. You will say something. The question is, what are you loading it with? Are you loading it with the word of God, or are you loading it with fear, complaint, doubt, negativity, and the language of defeat? Let me take you to another scripture that amplifies this. Numbers chapter 14 verse 28. God himself, Jehovah Elohim, spoke to the children of Israel who had been murmuring and complaining. And he said something that should shake every one of us. He said, "As truly as I live, sayeth the Lord, as you have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you." Did you catch that? God said, "What you have been saying, I heard it. And I am going to give you exactly what you have been declaring." They said we would die in this wilderness. God said granted. You will die in this wilderness. They said we cannot take the land. God said agreed. You will not take the land. Not because God was incapable. Not because the giants were too strong, but because they used their own mouths to legislate their own defeat. And that is what is happening to many believers today. You are praying in the prayer room for breakthrough, but in the kitchen, in the car, on the phone with your friend, you are saying nothing ever works for me. I will never get married. This sickness will kill me. My family is cursed. I do not think I will make it. And God is saying as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you. Your words are not just sounds. They are spiritual containers. They carry creative force. They have legal standing in the courts of heaven and in the courts of hell. When you speak, both kingdoms listen. Both kingdoms respond. Angels hearken to the voice of God's word, but they also recognize when you are contradicting what God has said. And demons, listen to me carefully, demons take your negative confessions and use them as legal evidence to enforce bondage in your life. This is why I want to give you 10 words tonight. 10 words that if you will speak them every single morning before your feet hit the ground, before you check your phone, before you open your email, before you look at the news, 10 words that will restructure the spiritual atmosphere of your entire day. And these 10 words come from scripture. They are not motivational quotes. They are not positive affirmations from a self-help book. They are the living, breathing, fire-charged word of the almighty God. Here they are. Psalm 118:24. Say it with me. This is the day the Lord has made. Count them. This is the day the Lord has made. 10 words, but inside those 10 words is a universe of power, authority, and prophetic legislation. Now, let me break this open for you because if you say these words without understanding what you are releasing, they become religious ritual. But when revelation meets declaration, an explosion happens in the spirit. Listen carefully. There are dimensions to this. When you say this, you are being specific. You are not talking about yesterday, which is gone. You are not talking about tomorrow, which is not guaranteed. You are pointing your spiritual finger at this day, the one you just woke up in, the one that is still being formed. You are marking it. You are tagging it in the realm of the spirit. You are saying this day, not any other day, this specific 24-hour window, I am speaking over it now. When you say it's the day, you are making a present tense declaration. Not this was the day, not this will be the day. Is, present tense, active, alive. You are establishing reality in real time. You are not waiting for something to happen. You are declaring what already I S in the mind of God because before this day ever reached the calendar, it existed in the council of the Almighty. Psalm 139:16, "Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect, and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them." God wrote this day before you lived it. And his version of this day is not the version the devil has planned. So when you say this is the day, you are aligning yourself with God's version. You are rejecting the counterfeit. You are choosing the original. When you say the Lord has made, oh, this is where the fire is. You are declaring ownership. This day does not belong to the economy. This day does not belong to your boss. This day does not belong to the government. This day does not belong to the devil. The Lord made it. Jehovah fashioned it. El Shaddai designed it. And if he made it, then he has embedded blessings in it. He has hidden favor in it. He has woven miracles into its fabric. He has positioned angels along its corridors. He has prearranged divine encounters within its hours. When you say the Lord has made, past tense, it is already done. The making is complete. The design is finished. The blessings are already loaded. You are not begging God to make the day good. You are declaring that he already has. You are agreeing with what heaven has already established. And that agreement, that alignment between your mouth and God's intention, is what unlocks everything. Thus said the spirit of God, the reason many people's days are chaotic, unproductive, full of trouble, full of confusion, is not because God did not design the day for good. It is because they never open their mouth to agree with his design. They never spoke, they never declared, they left the day unclaimed. And when you leave a day unclaimed in the spirit, the enemy files a counter claim. He says, "Since they did not declare God's agenda, I will impose mine." And he fills the day with setbacks, delays, arguments, accidents, missed opportunities, and spiritual attacks. But when you wake up and the first words out of your mouth are, "This is the day the Lord has made." You are filing a claim in the courts of heaven. You are posting a notice in the realm of the spirit that says, "This day is spoken for. This day has an owner. This day is under the jurisdiction of the most high God. And every demonic agenda assigned to this day is hereby overruled." Hallelujah. Mark 11:23, Jesus said, "For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed and be thou cast into the sea and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he said shall come to pass. He shall have whatsoever he said. Whosoever shall say The principle of the kingdom is not think it, not feel it, not wish it, say it. Because saying is what activates the creative power of faith in the spiritual realm. And it is not a coincidence that the rest of Psalm 118:24 says, I will rejoice and be glad in it. After the declaration comes the disposition. After you claim the day with your words, you set your heart to joy. Not because everything in your life is perfect, not because your bank account is full, not because your marriage is smooth, but because you have already declared whose day it is. And if it belongs to God, then rejoicing is the only appropriate response. Because the God who made the day will sustain the day. The God who designed the day will defend the day. And the God who ordained the day will fill the day with his goodness. Now, I want to go somewhere. Stay with me. When God created the world, Genesis chapter 1, every act of creation was preceded by speech. Verse 3, and God said, let there be light and there was light. Verse 6, and God said, let there be a firmament. Verse 9, and God said, let the waters be gathered. Verse 11, and God said, let the earth bring forth. God did not think the world into existence. He did not meditate the world into existence. He spoke. He said. And what he said became what he saw. And you are made in his image. Genesis 1:27, that means the creative power of speech that God possesses, a measure of it lives inside you. When you speak according to his will, according to his word, according to his purpose, things shift, circumstances bend, barriers break, opportunities materialize, health is restored, favor is activated, the invisible becomes visible. But here is the key, and I need someone to write this in their spirit. The power of your words is connected to the timing of your words. When you speak, matters as much as what you speak. And the morning is the most strategic time to release your words. Psalm 5:3, David said, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." David understood that the morning is the gateway. It is the first draft of the day. Whatever is written in the first draft sets the tone for the final version. If you allow fear to write the first draft of your morning, the rest of the day will be a fearful manuscript. If you allow anxiety to write the first draft, the rest of the day reads like a horror novel. But if you allow the word of God to write the first draft, if the first thing that flows from your lips is a declaration from heaven, the rest of the day becomes a prophetic document authored by the Holy Ghost. Lamentations 3:23, "They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." God's mercies are calibrated to the morning. They reset, they refresh, they reload. Every morning, God serves you a fresh plate of mercy. But if you do not open your mouth to receive it, it sits there untouched. And you go through the day running on yesterday's fumes, when God had prepared today's fuel. I decree and I declare over everyone connected to this word from tonight, your mornings will never be the same. You will not wake up to your phone, you will not wake up to social media. You will not wake up to the news. You will wake up to the word of the Lord. Your first breath will carry a declaration. Your first words will be a prophecy over your own life and heaven will respond. Angels will mobilize. Doors will unlock. Enemies will scatter and the trajectory of your day and your life will shift irreversibly. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now, I want to pray and this prayer is not gentle. This is not a lullaby. This is warfare. This is legislation. This is prophetic activation and I need you to be fully engaged, not passive, not distracted. Engage your spirit. Open your mouth and pray with me. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come before your throne tonight not as a beggar, but as a son. I come with boldness because Hebrews 4:16 says I may come boldly onto the throne of grace and I bring every person connected to this moment into the courtroom of heaven. I decree that from this night forward the mouths of your people are sanctified. Every tongue is set on fire, not with the fire of hell as James 3 warns, but with the fire of the Holy Ghost. I decree that the words they speak every morning carry creative power. That when they declare this is the day the Lord has made, heaven responds, angels activate and every contrary plan of the enemy is overruled. I speak to every mouth that has been used as an instrument of self-destruction. Every mouth that has been speaking death instead of life. Every tongue that has been confessing fear, failure, defeat and impossibility, I break the pattern tonight. I reverse the flow. From this moment your mouth becomes a weapon of mass construction. What you say will build. What you declare will establish. What you decree will manifest. Isaiah 57:19, "I create the fruit of the lips." Lord, create new fruit on the lips of your people. Let the fruit of your lips bring healing, breakthrough, favor, promotion, restoration, and divine acceleration. Now, I pray over specific areas. Agree with me. I speak to your destiny tonight. The destiny that has been locked, I command it to open. Every spiritual padlock that has been placed on someone's purpose, I break it by the authority of Christ. Every demonic seal over your calling, I melt it by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Jeremiah 1:5, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. And before thou camest forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee." You were not born by accident. You were sanctified before birth. You were ordained before you took your first breath. And I decree that the ordination activates now. What God said about you in eternity is catching up with you in time. The delay is broken. The confusion is lifted. You will know what you are called to do. You will see with clarity, and you will move with precision. I speak to families. I cover every household connected to this word with the blood of Jesus. Every spirit of separation bound. Every spirit of misunderstanding between husband and wife, rebuked. Every demonic interference in someone's home, dismantled. Psalm 128:3-4, "Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house. Thy children like olive plants round about thy table. Behold, that those shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord." I decree that blessing upon every home tonight. Fruitfulness in marriage, peace in the household, children who serve the Lord. A table that is full, a home that is a habitation of the Holy Ghost, not a battleground of demons. I speak to those believing God for a spouse. I decree that the waiting has produced what it was supposed to produce. And now the meeting is at hand. The one God has prepared is being released towards you. Not by manipulation, not by desperation, by divine orchestration. Ruth 2:3, and her hap was to light on a path of the field belonging onto Boaz. It looked like chance. It looked like coincidence, but it was God. And God is orchestrating a coincidence for you that will change everything. This is the season. I speak to finances. I decree that every financial gate that has been rusted shut is oiled by the anointing of the Holy Ghost and swung open tonight. Deuteronomy 8:18, but thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth. I activate that power over your life. The power to create wealth. The power to multiply resources, the power to attract favor, the power to generate ideas that produce income. Every devourer assigned to your finances, Malachi 3:11, I rebuke you in the name of Jesus. You will not consume their seed. You will not steal their harvest. You will not sabotage their investments. The leaking is over. The bleeding is stopped. Provision flows. Abundance overflows. Storehouses fill. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is showing me there is a business idea you buried because someone told you it was foolish. But the Lord says dig it up. That idea was from me. I planted it in your spirit for this season. What they call foolish, I call strategic. And if you will obey, the returns will silence every critic. I speak to your health. 3 John verse 2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth." I decree health. Complete health. Not manage illness, health. Not control symptoms, healing. Every organ function, every cell regenerate, every blood vessel be cleansed. Every nerve respond to the command of the Holy Ghost. I speak specifically, someone has been dealing with chronic headaches. The kind that no medication fully resolves. The Lord is showing me that this is tied to a spiritual attack on your mind. The enemy is trying to shut down your ability to think, to pray, to plan, to dream. But I break it now. I command every tormenting spirit assigned to your head to leave in the name of Jesus. The fire of God descends on your skull, on your brain, on every nerve ending. You are free. The pain stops tonight, and it does not come back. Shikandala Remobela Koshi. Rabashika Ramendola Siribe. Hallelujah. I come against covenants. I come against ancestral agreements that are still speaking. Every vow that was made by a forefather to any deity, I renounce it by the blood of Jesus. Every sacrifice that was offered on any altar, whether at a river, a grove, a mountain, a crossroad. Every sacrifice that is still demanding payment from this generation, I declare the payment is void. Jesus paid it all. Hebrews 9 verse 12, "Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, Having obtained eternal redemption for us, the blood of Jesus is the final sacrifice. No other payment is required. No other blood is needed. Every altar is closed. Every covenant is terminated. The chain breaks tonight. Every evil pattern repeating in your family, premature death, divorce, poverty, insanity, addiction, I cut the root. I go to the foundation. I pull out the seed that was planted generations ago and I burn it with the fire of the Holy Ghost. The pattern does not continue. The cycle does not repeat. It ends with you. It dies with you. Your children will not inherit it. Your grandchildren will not carry it. The bloodline is purified by the blood of Jesus. I pray for angelic reinforcement. Psalm 103:20, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." As I speak the word of the Lord tonight, I release angels, ministering angels, warring angels, guarding angels. Angels assigned to your destiny, your family, your finances, your health, your relationships, I release them into action. Go before them and clear the path. STAND BESIDE THEM and provide strength. Follow behind them and close every door the enemy will try to reenter through. Hebrews 1:14, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" You are an heir of salvation. And the angelic ministry is activated on your behalf tonight. I speak against witchcraft. Every coven that has assembled against your progress, I scatter it. Every incantation that has been chanted over your name, I silence it. Every spell that has been cast over your career, your marriage, your ministry, your health, I nullify it by the superior power of the blood of the lamb. Revelation 12:11, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." The blood overcomes, the blood defeats, the blood silences, and the blood is speaking right now over your life. What no weapon could achieve the blood accomplishes. I speak to time and virtue. Joel 2:25, "I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten." I invoke restoration. Every year that was consumed by confusion returned. Every season that was wasted in the wrong relationship redeemed. Every opportunity that passed because you were not ready recycled by the mercy of God. And every virtue, every strength, every anointing, every gift, every grace that was extracted from you, whether by demonic operation, evil association, or spiritual drainage, I command a sevenfold return. Proverbs 6:31, "The thief must pay and the payment is due tonight." I speak to divine preservation for this entire season. Psalm 121:7, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil." I speak safety over every journey. I speak protection over every sleep. I speak covering over every transition. No sudden calamity, no hidden trap, no orchestrated accident, no poison gift, no friendly enemy. Nothing the devil has designed will reach you. The hedge of Almighty God, Job 1:10, surrounds you on every side. Rabashikaramendobekayamilo, shondalarikosemeribaloshan. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Someone, the Lord is pressing this me. Someone watching right now, you have been on the verge of giving up, not just on a dream, on everything. You have been so weary, so exhausted, so battered by wave after wave of disappointment that you have mentally checked out. You are going through the motions, but inside you have already quit. The Lord says, "I am breathing on you right now." Isaiah 40:29-31, "I give power to the faint, and to them that have no might, I increase strength." Even the youth shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall, but they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. He says, "You are not done. I am not done with you." The story is not over. There are chapters yet unwritten, and the next chapter is the one that redeems every painful page that came before. And there is someone, a woman the Lord is showing me, you have been carrying a secret burden, something you have not told anyone, not your pastor, not your friend, not your family, and the weight of it has been crushing you silently. The Lord says, "I see you. I know, and I am not angry. I am not disgusted. I am not ashamed of you. I am reaching into that dark place right now, and I am pulling you out." 2 Corinthians 12:9, "My grace is sufficient for thee. My strength is made perfect in your weakness." Whatever the burden is, shame, guilt, addiction, fear, a past that haunts you, he says, "Lay it down. Tonight, right here, in my presence, and I will carry what you were never meant to carry." There is a man, I sense this strongly, there is a man whose business has been failing, not because he is lazy, not because he lacks skill, but because there is a spiritual blockage. The Lord is showing me it is connected to a property, a piece of land, something that was acquired and there was a problem with the spiritual history of that land. The Lord says, "Sanctify the ground. Pray over that property, anoint it, consecrate it because the land itself is contesting what you are trying to build on it. I break that contest in the name of Jesus." Whatever spirit is attached to that land, I command you to vacate. The blood of Jesus cleanses the ground. The fire of the Holy Ghost purifies the atmosphere. And from now, what you build will stand. What you plant will grow. What you invest will yield. Hallelujah. I am sealing this word now. I am sealing every declaration. I am sealing every prophecy. I am sealing every prayer by the authority invested in me as a servant of the most high God, I decree tomorrow morning when you open your eyes, the first thing you will say is, "This is the day the Lord has made." And the moment those 10 words leave your mouth, something will shift in the spiritual atmosphere over your day. Angels will take their positions. Demons will retreat. Doors will unlock. Favor will locate you. Protection will surround you. And the blessing of the Lord, Proverbs 10:22, "The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich and he added no sorrow with it." That blessing will follow you every hour of every day. I decree that your mouth is no longer a weapon of self-destruction. It is a prophetic instrument of divine creation. What you say will come to pass. What you declare will be established. Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." The siege over your life is broken. The embargo on your progress is lifted. The satanic surveillance over your destiny is disrupted. The chains are falling. The gates are opening. The walls are crumbling. And you you are walking into the most fruitful, most productive, most supernaturally charged season of your entire life. I decree that this week carries your testimony. Something will happen tangible, undeniable, miraculous that will cause you to say it was the hand of God. Nothing else explains it. And when that happens, and it will happen, remember this moment. Remember these 10 words and never stop saying them. This is the day the Lord has made. I will rejoice. I will be glad in it. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, the communion, the fellowship, the koinonia of the Holy Spirit be with you from this moment and forevermore. In Jesus' mighty name. Amen and amen and amen. Hallelujah.
